beats.summary: Dwight and Michael argue over the origin and credit of the golden ticket idea.

evidence.snippet: Michael: I can't… vouch for that. But I do know this. He is a liar. He has taken my idea.

beats.summary: David Wallace announces that the golden ticket discount has secured a major client for Dunder Mifflin.

evidence.snippet: David: I just want to say that this golden ticket idea is one of the most brilliant signs of initiative I have ever seen at this company

beats.summary: Jim advises Dwight not to take the fall for someone else, but Dwight insists on returning to work and writing Jim up for insubordination.

evidence.snippet: Jim: You cannot take the fall for him.
Dwight: I'm gonna go back to work. After I write you up for insubordination.
